items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the Chern class, the Chern character and the Chern polynomials of a perfect object E on X as bivariant classes, assuming that after some envelope Y -> X the pullback becomes a locally bounded complex of finite locally free modules, and asserts that they are independent of that envelope (statement lines 9212-9227, tag 0GUD). The proof builds the classes on every test scheme, verifies that base change acts by restriction, and then feeds the construction into the descent lemma for bivariant classes along an envelope, checking the hypothesis through the two projections; independence of the envelope is obtained by the same descent applied to the product envelope. The organisation of these descents is the substance, so the claim is H2.
